active_basis: Only combined reviewed categories meeting previously stated20train/5val/5test distinct-photo floor. Eligibility uses annotation coverage only; no test model outcomes.

training.start: Original pinned pretrained RF-DETR Small; never7758628
training.inactive_main_classifier_rows: zero gradient, zero weight decay, bitwise identity checked
training.sampling: 2active-positive +2explicit-negative per update, independently shuffled fixed pools

selection.guard: Every reviewed class individually: complete TP cannot decrease, complete FP cannot increase, partial known hits cannot decrease versus step0. Also total unscored predictions may rise by at most5 (drift alarm, not false-positive count).
selection.ranking: Among eligible checkpoints, increase total reviewed-positive hits, then complete-scope F1; exact ties retain earlier step. Step0 remains selected if none improves.

evaluation.adoption: Separate gate: no complete-scope FP increase or reviewed-positive recall loss on heldout and frozen video evidence; require useful strict gain. No automatic app integration.
evaluation.limits: Small purposive assistant-reviewed evidence; not statistically representative independent accuracy.

deferred_categories: Remaining16 priority categories retained in dataset and hold ledger; insufficient coverage for this trial. No claim of expanded learned615-class recognition.
